premise: Acorn wishes on the brightest star for a friend to stay up with her; the star floats down and it is Firefly.
inspiration: The star-wishing motif of folk tales, turned: the wonder is not magic but a friend who heard.
lesson: Sometimes a wish comes true because a friend is listening.

en-US.title: Acorn Wishes on a Star
en-US.text: {sfx:crickets} {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] It was bedtime, and the sky was full of stars. Acorn {acorn:pulse} couldn't sleep. [whispers] Owl, she said, do stars really grant wishes? Owl {owl:pulse} blinked his big round eyes. {owl:face happy} Some say so, he said. Pick the brightest one. So Acorn looked, and looked. There! One little star, lower than all the others, twinkling just above the grass. {acorn:glow} [curious] I wish, whispered Acorn, for a friend to stay up with me. And the star… {firefly:float loop 0.3} came floating down. Closer. And closer. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] It wasn't a star at all. It was Firefly! {firefly:glow} {firefly:face happy} I heard you, she said. I'm up too! {acorn:face happy} [happily] So Acorn and Firefly made wishes together, {acorn:hearts} {firefly:sparkle} and Owl kept watch until Acorn was {acorn:face sleeping} fast asleep.

es-ES.title: Bellota pide un deseo
es-ES.text: {sfx:crickets} {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] Era hora de dormir, y el cielo estaba lleno de estrellas. Bellota {acorn:pulse} no podía dormirse. [whispers] Búho, dijo, ¿de verdad las estrellas conceden deseos? Búho {owl:pulse} parpadeó con sus grandes ojos redondos. {owl:face happy} Eso dicen, contestó. Elige la que más brille. Así que Bellota miró, y miró. ¡Allí! Una estrellita más bajita que las demás, brillando justo encima de la hierba. {acorn:glow} [curious] Deseo, susurró Bellota, una amiga que se quede despierta conmigo. Y la estrella… {firefly:float loop 0.3} bajó flotando. Más cerca. Y más cerca. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] No era una estrella. ¡Era Luciérnaga! {firefly:glow} {firefly:face happy} Te he oído, dijo. ¡Yo también estoy despierta! {acorn:face happy} [happily] Así que Bellota y Luciérnaga pidieron deseos juntas, {acorn:hearts} {firefly:sparkle} y Búho vigiló hasta que Bellota {acorn:face sleeping} se quedó dormida.

crickets.prompt: quiet night crickets in a summer meadow, very soft
